settings.update_cmd_description: Trusted shell command run only by Update. A selected configuration is appended as a quoted --config argument. Checks always use Topgrade dry-run. The default uses --notify-end never to suppress Topgrade completion notifications.
settings.terminal_cmd_description: Empty uses Noctalia terminal detection. Trusted shell prefix, e.g. xdg-terminal-exec --title="System Update" or kitty -e. The plugin appends sh -c and the safely quoted supervised update; include any terminal command separator yourself.
settings.config_description: Empty uses Topgrade's own configuration lookup. Used by discovery and appended to the update command as a safely quoted --config argument.
settings.auto_description: Checks Pacman/AUR after 10 seconds and periodically thereafter. Zero disables automatic checks.
settings.notify_on_updates_description: Notify once when a fully successful check finds Pacman/AUR updates, using Noctalia's normal notification sound settings. Failed, incomplete, empty, or dismissed checks stay silent. A new scheduled or manual check clears dismissal.
settings.download_size_description: Estimate pending Pacman repository package sizes from local sync metadata. Excludes AUR, includes cached packages, and may be stale. Missing metadata hides the estimate without affecting counts.
settings.glyph_description: Noctalia native glyph name for the bar widget (default: pacman). For example, package.
settings.hide: Hide when Pacman/AUR are up to date
settings.hide_description: Enabled by default; hide when the displayed Pacman/AUR total is missing or zero, even during checks, updates, or uncertain results. Positive incomplete counts stay visible with a warning. Disable to keep empty results visible; dismissal still hides the widget.
